purpose: Contract-first enforcement for SKILL.md. `entries` are framework-pickers — naming one implicitly rules out alternatives (CRITICAL: auto-REJECT). `warnings` are domain libraries that might be the skill's legitimate subject (IMPORTANT: voice-reviewer subagent judgment). Detector is case-insensitive with word boundaries; English-word collisions (requests, click, fetch, bootstrap, guidance, anthropic, openai, typescript) are deliberately excluded.

sources.name: hugovk — Top PyPI packages (monthly, by download count).
sources.role: Canonical JSON feed for Python library popularity. Structure: .rows[].project. Seeds the PyPI-derived entries.

sources.name: tristan-f-r/npm-rank — Top npm packages (monthly release).
sources.role: Canonical JSON feed for npm library popularity. Structure: [].name. Seeds the npm-derived entries.

sources.name: crates.io API — Rust crate popularity (CC0 data).
sources.role: Canonical JSON feed for Rust. Not yet sampled into entries but available for future ecosystem expansion.

sources.name: libraries.io — Multi-ecosystem SourceRank open dataset.
sources.role: Cross-ecosystem popularity metric (CC-BY-SA). Useful for future validation and for ecosystems lacking a dedicated JSON feed.

sources.name: anthropics/skills — skill-creator and claude-api SKILL.md.
sources.role: Canonical Anthropic-authored skills. skill-creator is the model of contract-first voice (few library names); claude-api is the counter-example (names SDKs in body). Used to calibrate which library names most commonly leak into instructional prose.

sources.name: PatrickJS/awesome-cursorrules — corpus of AI-coding-assistant instructions.
sources.role: Corpus for identifying which libraries are most frequently named in AI instruction prose (Cursor rules, Copilot instructions).
